verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("lib/pricing/gates.ts","utf8");if(!/custom_domain/.test(s)){console.error("lib/pricing/gates.ts has no custom_domain gate");process.exit(1)}const {execSync}=require("child_process");const n=execSync("grep -rl custom_domain app lib --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | grep -v test | wc -l").toString().trim();if(+n<2){console.error("custom_domain is defined but enforced nowhere ("+n+" files)");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: The custom_domain gate is in lib/pricing/gates.ts (Business and up) with its tier ladder, and is enforced where a host is served: getSpaceByDomain does not resolve a Space without the plan, so the request falls back to the root Space. It is a gate, not a meter (the repo's gate-or-meter rule; one domain per Space is structural, recorded in NON_METERED_FEATURES). The space_whitelabel DB row was already gone (pricing_feature_gates is empty in production, reset by 20270201000000), so no migration. When the Sites bind action is built it calls the same gate. Inert while the gates are soft.
